title: Scalar Rademacher norm and linear form
statement: Let $a=(a_1,\\ldots,a_n)\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$ and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The Rademacher norm of $a$ at $x$ equals the absolute value of the linear form $\\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: a is a real-valued coefficient vector on the n coordinates
x is a sign vector of length n
